title: Rosalind and the Spire
author: Ulyana Eastwick
blurb: Kestrel Crane, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
